title: A Page in a Gauntlet
author: Ser Aldo Venn of the Tolling Order
body:
# Folded in a knight's gauntlet

*The page is the Order's count-paper; the hand is steady until the end.*

---

The doors fell outward at the turn of the night, both together, with no sound. The note came out after them and went over the heath like water over a sill.

I was set to keep the doors shut. The doors are not shut. So I am going in after the note, to put it back.

If a chorister comes after me, a woman, grey, with a voice like Cadwen's mother's: tell her I went in of my own will, and not to follow.

*Under it, in another hand, very small:* She followed.

title: A Founder's Tally
author: a founder of the dead city, in chalk
body:
# Chalked on a board in the loam store

*Strokes in rows, a row a day, and words beside some of them.*

---

Metal held in the runs. Furnace banked. Master says it will be ready to pour in the morning.

Metal held. Furnace banked. Master says the morning.

Ash on the pit. Cope cracking on the road side. Master says the morning.

*Rows of strokes, a great many, the chalk worn thin, no words.*

*The last line:* Master says it is ready. Master says it is never ready. Master says the morning.

title: The Captain's Last Report
author: Captain Rook Haddow, Wardens of the Hearth, Chalkwatch
body:
# To the Rest, by the beacon if the beacon will light

*Sealed, never sent. The seal is a Warden's, green wax gone grey.*

---

The line has moved. It moved at the second watch, the length of the heath in the time it takes to say so, and it is past us. The beacon will not light: the fire goes grey in the basket. The men are on the walls. Nobody has left his post.

I will read the roll at the evening watch as is proper and I will send this when the beacon lights.

All present.

*Over the page, many times, in the same hand:* All present. All present. All present.
